label: PF Backlog 377
title: API reference docs: generated searchable HTML (TOC) + JSON + PDF render API
body: Generate a searchable API reference (sidebar TOC by tag; method/path/summary/auth/params/request/responses; plus entry-path flow) from the canonical api/openapi.json. Expose GET /api/v1/apidocs.json (structured) and GET /api/v1/apidocs (HTML), and POST /api/v1/apidocs/render?format=pdf|html (operator -> artifact). Commit docs/api-reference.html with a freshness gate. Schemas from current OpenAPI (typed models later).

delivery.note: reviewed, precheck PASS, merged to develop

dashboard_impact.reason: API reference is served from api/; dashboard may consume the same OpenAPI later, no dashboard item required now
